compress.description: Compression algorithm for the initramfs image (e.g., gzip, xz, zstd, lz4, none)

modules.description: Module detection method: 'dep' (automatic via dependency tree), 'most' (load most modules), or 'list' (use MODULES_LIST)

modules_list.description: Explicit list of modules to include if MODULES=list

items.description: Kernel module name to include in the initramfs

rootfstype.description: Filesystem type of the root partition

device.description: Early boot device(s) needed to access the root (e.g., 'usb_storage', 'ahci')

rootdelay.description: Seconds to wait for the root device to appear (0 = no wait, auto-detect)

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging during initramfs execution

addmodules.description: Additional kernel modules to load early (e.g., LVM, encryption, RAID drivers)

hooks.description: Initramfs hooks to include in the image

items.description: Hook script name (e.g., base, lvm2, cryptsetup, nfs)

post_build.description: Shell command(s) to run after initramfs generation (e.g., signing, compression tweaks)

compressoptions.description: Options to pass to the compressor (e.g., ['-9'] for gzip)

extrahooks.description: Additional hooks to include beyond the default set

removehooks.description: Hooks to explicitly exclude from the initramfs

all_kernels.description: Generate initramfs for all installed kernels (if false, only current kernel)

keep_old.description: Keep previous initramfs images instead of overwriting

blacklist.description: Kernel modules to exclude from the initramfs

use_plymouth.description: Enable Plymouth for graphical boot splash

pre_stream.description: Modules to load before root filesystem mount (e.g., for network boot)
